description: App-local IANA time zone data (tzdata 2026f) for .NET on Linux and macOS. Ships compiled TZif files and sets TZDIR via an explicit TzDataRuntime.Configure() call, so TimeZoneInfo works on Alpine, Chiseled and Distroless images without system tzdata. Windows is a no-op (NLS/registry).

Opt-in automatic TZDIR setup for TzData.Runtime. Injects a module initializer into executable projects (Exe/WinExe) so TzDataRuntime.Configure() runs before Main. Does nothing on Windows. Disable with TzDataRuntimeAutoInit=false.
